# Superpowers upstream

This directory vendors the complete `skills/` tree from [`obra/superpowers`](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) so the repository's GitHub Copilot Superpowers agent is self-contained.

- Upstream commit: `b36e0829c6d0140e93cfef2ca599b1b07d4a7797`
- Vendored subtree: `skills/`
- License: MIT, copied here as `LICENSE`
- Local integration: `.github/agents/superpowers.agent.md`

Do not hand-edit vendored upstream skill files. Update them by deliberately re-vendoring from a reviewed upstream commit, then run the repository release gate.
